chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah al-Dahqan, from Durust, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
A Prophet from the Prophets (peace be upon them) complained to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, about the scarcity of offspring, so He said: 'Eat the meat with the eggs.'
ai.seo_question: What did Allah advise a Prophet to eat to increase his offspring?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, a Prophet complains to Allah about low progeny, receiving the divine advice to consume meat with eggs, which Shia scholars interpret as a specific dietary remedy for fertility. This hadith is frequently cited in Islamic medical jurisprudence (*tibb*) to support the nutritional and reproductive benefits of combining protein sources, reflecting the tradition's emphasis on practical health guidance derived from prophetic experience.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Al Dahqan, from Dorost, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A Prophet<sup>as</sup> from the Prophets<sup>as</sup> complained to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic of the scarcity of the offspring. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said: “Eat the meat with the eggs”.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Ubayd Allah ibn ‘Abd Allah al-Dihqan from Durust from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One of the prophets complained before Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, about not having any children. He (Allah) told him to eat meat with egg.’”
